servinfo.title: Front Wheel Hub Assembly and Steering Knuckle Removal and Installation

ptxt.intxrefpoff: Front Wheel Hub Assembly and Steering Knuckle Components:Front

item.ptxt: If the steering knuckle is removed and installed without care, the front brake disc dust cover may damage the dust cover of the suspension arm joint.
When removing and installing the steering knuckle assembly, do not damage the suspension arm joint dust cover.
If front wheel speed sensor receives large shock, the sensor could be damaged.
Do not drop or expose the sensor to large shock.
Any front wheel speed sensor that has received large shock should be replaced.
If front wheel speed sensor is brought closer to magnetic force, the sensor could become inoperative.
Do not bring the sensor closer to magnetic force.

s1.ptxt: Hoist vehicle and remove front wheel.
Remove drive shaft nut.
Remove front wheel speed sensor.
Remove brake disc and brake caliper.
Disconnect tie-rod end from steering knuckle.
Disconnect suspension arm joint from steering knuckle.
Remove strut bracket nuts and bolts.
Remove steering knuckle (1), front wheel hub assembly (2) and front brake disc dust cover (3) all together from strut bracket (4).
Remove wheel hub housing bolts (1), and remove front wheel hub assembly (3) and front brake disc dust cover (4) from steering knuckle (2).
Remove hub bolts (1) with copper hammer or hydraulic press, if necessary.

attention4.ptxt: Removing the hub bolts will break the serrations on the hub bolts.
Avoid removing the hub bolts unless their replacement is absolutely necessary. If the hub bolts are removed, never reuse the bolts.

s1.ptxt: Insert new hub bolts (1) in hub holes, if removed. Rotate each hub bolt slowly to assure that serrations are aligned with those made by original bolt and then press-fit one by one.
Apply grease to mating surface of front wheel hub assembly (1) for front drive shaft.
Install front brake disc dust cover (3) and front wheel hub assembly (2) to steering knuckle (1) and tighten new wheel hub housing bolts (4) to specified torque.

attention4.ptxt: The wheel hub housing bolts are pre-coated with friction stabilizer. If the bolts are reused, they may work loose.
Use new wheel hub housing bolts.

s1.ptxt: Install steering knuckle (1) with front brake disc dust cover (4) and front wheel hub assembly (3) to strut bracket (2).
Install strut bracket bolts and nuts.
Connect steering knuckle to suspension arm.
Connect tie-rod end to steering knuckle.
Install brake disc and brake caliper.
Install front wheel speed sensor.
Tighten new drive shaft nut to specified torque.
Install front wheel.
Check front wheel alignment.
